intro_html: Moving a deal forward is worth celebrating — and worth marketing. The moment a dossier crosses into Under Contract, Clear to Close, or Closed, Dossie draws a branded 1080×1080 card on the spot: no designer, no Canva template, no remembering to make one before the moment's gone.

steps.p: Dossie pops a celebration card built for that exact milestone: headline, subhead, city and state, gold border, Dossie mark — all on-brand, no template to fill in.
Share straight to Instagram or Facebook, copy the image, or download the PNG — the card is also saved to the dossier's Milestones tab so it's never lost.

callout: Privacy-safe by design: the card shows only city and state — never the buyer or seller's name, never the street address, never the sale price.
cta_title: Turn your next closing into a post.
cta_sub: Dossie generates a branded, shareable card the moment a deal hits a real milestone — built for Texas agents.

faq.q: Which milestones generate a shareable card?
faq.a: Three: Under Contract, Clear to Close, and Closed. Each has its own headline and subhead, drawn fresh every time a dossier reaches that stage.

faq.q: Is any private deal information shown on the card?
faq.a: No. The card shows only the property's city and state — never buyer or seller names, the street address, or the sale price. It's built to be safe to post publicly.

faq.q: Where do past milestone cards go after I share them?
faq.a: Every card is saved to that dossier's Milestones section automatically, so you can reopen, re-download, or re-share it later without redoing the work.

faq.q: Can I share the card from my phone?
faq.a: Yes — on mobile, the share buttons open your device's native share sheet straight to Instagram or Facebook. On desktop, Dossie downloads the PNG so you can attach it yourself.
